items.title: Sylvester Handy Interview, 1961-12-13
items.q: We worked from Rhapsody to San Jacinto... Beansie still would take out the money for his violin until it was paid for... Jerry Green, he joined the band... And he worked with them for years and years and years.

ctx.x: I said, I like that very much.

All right. Beans, they say, you like that? I say, yes, sir. He said, well, he likes this violin. How much is this violin? They told him $300-something. He said, how much, Sylvester, how much you want to put out on it? I look at Beansie, you know, I ain't had nothing to put out on it. You understand? So, he looked back at me and I looked back at him and he said, well, I put $100 down on it. And they made arrangements for Beansie to take out so much every month or every week.
